== povray.pov
#declare GL_Light0 = <1250, 1250, -1250>;
#declare GL_Light1 = <-1000, 500, -1000>;
#declare GL_Diffuse = <0.7, 0.7, 0.7>;

#include "settings.inc"

#include concat(concat(str(clock,-5,0)),".inc")

#version 3.8;

// Main POV file generated by Bullet Physics Playground

global_settings {
  assumed_gamma 1.0
  max_trace_level 15
}

== 00001.inc
#declare use_focal_blur = 0; // 0=off 1=low quality 10=high quality

#version 3.8;

// --- Fog (background haze) ---
fog {
  fog_type 1
  distance 200
  color rgb <0.85, 0.9, 0.95>
}

// --- Lights ---

// Directional rim light from behind
light_source {
  <0, -1, -1>
  color rgb <0.8, 0.8, 1>
  parallel
}

// Fill light: illuminates the interior but emits no photons
light_source {
  <8, 12, 8>
  color rgb <0.7, 0.8, 1>
  photons { reflection off }
}

// Include file generated by Bullet Physics Playground

// Spotlight beam entering the room, passing through the glass box
light_source {
  <-8, 15, -8>
  color rgb <1, 1, 1>
  spotlight
  point_at <0, 3, 0>
  radius 0.5
  tightness 80
  falloff 50
}

box { <-3, -3, -3>, <3, 3, 3>
  texture {
    pigment { rgbt <1, 1, 1, 0.3> }
  }
  no_reflection
  hollow
  matrix <1,0,0,
          0,1,0,
          0,0,1,
          0,3,0>
  photons { pass_through }
}

camera {
  location < -12, 6, 12 >
  right image_width/image_height*x
  look_at <707095, 6, -707095>   angle degrees(2*atan(tan(radians(45)/2)*image_width/image_height))
  sky <-1.92913e-17, 1, 5.20941e-17>
#if(use_focal_blur)
  aperture 0
  blur_samples 10*use_focal_blur
  focal_point <0, 0, 0>   confidence 0.9+(use_focal_blur*0.0085)
  variance 1/(2000*use_focal_blur)
#end
}

global_settings {
  assumed_gamma 1.0
  max_trace_level 15
  adc_bailout 0.001

  // Photons interact with scattering media (media 100 = 100% interaction)
  photons {
    count 20000
    media 100
  }
}

plane { <0, 1, 0>, 0
  texture {
    pigment { rgbt <1, 1, 1, 0> }
  }
  matrix <1,0,0,
          0,1,0,
          0,0,1,
          0,0,0>
  hollow
  finish { reflection <0.5, 0.4, 0.2> }
  photons { target reflection on }
}

plane { <0, 0, -1>, 0
  texture {
    pigment { rgbt <1, 1, 1, 0> }
  }
  matrix <1,0,0,
          0,1,0,
          0,0,1,
          0,0,-20>
  no_reflection
  hollow
}

plane { <0, 1, 0>, 0
  texture {
    pigment { rgbt <1, 1, 1, 0> }
  }
  matrix <1,0,0,
          0,1,0,
          0,0,1,
          0,20,0>
  no_reflection
  hollow
}

plane { <1, 0, 0>, 0
  texture {
    pigment { rgbt <1, 1, 1, 0> }
  }
  matrix <1,0,0,
          0,1,0,
          0,0,1,
          -20,0,0>
  no_reflection
  hollow
}

plane { <1, 0, 0>, 0
  texture {
    pigment { rgbt <1, 1, 1, 0> }
  }
  matrix <1,0,0,
          0,1,0,
          0,0,1,
          20,0,0>
  no_reflection
  hollow
}

sphere { <.0,.0,.0>, 0.2
  texture {
    pigment { rgbt <1, 1, 1, 0> }
  }
  matrix <1,0,0,
          0,1,0,
          0,0,1,
          8,12,-8>
  no_image
  no_reflection
  photons { reflection off }
}

sphere { <.0,.0,.0>, 0.2
  texture {
    pigment { rgbt <1, 1, 1, 0> }
  }
  matrix <1,0,0,
          0,1,0,
          0,0,1,
          -8,15,8>
  no_image
  no_reflection
}
